messages:
elaine-cs: FYI Caspian go-live greenlight checklist — need confirmation on final quota, autoscale policy, and loadtest window. Qs: do we want steady ramp or step bursts?

sam-ops: We have 1,500 qps reserved for their dedicated pool. Recommend autoscale policy: min=200, target=800, max=1200, cooldown=60s. That gives headroom for bursts without overspend.

mike-eng: Agree with the policy. For the loadtest I can run a two-phase plan: 1) 30m steady at 800qps, 2) 10x step bursts of 1200 qps for 5m each. Proposed slot Tue 06:00 UTC.

lina-ml: Heads-up — we'll enable prefix KV cache for their chat-heavy flows which should reduce sustained qps by ~15%. Also planning to serve quantized model variant (gpt-small-q) on pool A with fallback to fp16 base.

elaine-cs: Good — please capture any rollback triggers so CS can signal customer. Main ask from Caspian: no visible error spikes and latency < 250ms p95.

mike-eng: Rollback triggers: error rate >1% sustained for 3m OR p95 >500ms for 5m. If triggered we fallback to hosted model route.

josh-prod: Can we get a short runbook snippet to paste to their ops team?

sam-ops: Copy for runbook: 

```
// Caspian dedicated pool failover
if (error_rate > 0.01 for 3m) {
  route: hosted-fallback
  alert: #oncall-eng
}
if (p95_latency > 500ms for 5m) {
  scale_back: true
  notify: cs@redwood
}
```

elaine-cs: Perfect. Mike, can you attach the loadtest command you'll use so CS can coordinate network/permission windows?

mike-eng: Using k6 for the ramp/step test. Command below — will point at their shadow API key (do not share publicly):

```
k6 run --vus 800 --duration 30m ramp-script.js --env TARGET=https://dedicated.caspian.redwood/v1/generate
// then step bursts
k6 run --vus 1200 --duration 5m burst-script.js --iterations 10
```

lina-ml: Quick note on metrics — we'll export model-level latency and kv_cache_hit_rate to the shared dashboard. Expect drop in tokens/sec during burst cold-starts.

elaine-cs: From account management: renewal watch flagged — they need solid SLO proof during this bring-up. Please capture post-test summary and perf graphs.

sam-ops: Will produce post-test report (30m + bursts) with token cost, p50/p95/p99, error breakdown, and scaling events. ETA Wed EOD.

josh-prod: Deploy-bot noted canary completed earlier, FYI.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: model-variant/gpt-small-q deployed to pool-A at 1712350100 :white_check_mark:

elaine-cs: OK team — action items: 1) Mike run scheduled Tue 06:00 UTC, 2) Sam finalize autoscale knobs in infra, 3) Lina hook up dashboard panels, 4) Sam + Mike produce post-test report for Wed EOD. I'll loop Caspian in after first steady phase. :thumbsup:

mike-eng: Ack, I'll post the test logs to the thread and attach grafana links once done.

sam-ops: I'll also add a temporary throttle cap to protect burst from affecting other tenants.

elaine-cs: Thanks all — capture any customer-facing notes and flags here so I don't miss anything when I brief them.
